question: Who is designated as the animal victim within the Kula tradition?
premises: The person is situated in the midst of the group of yoginīs.
Such a person is called paśu.
This designation is given in the Kula tradition.
inference: In the Kula tradition, the one situated in the midst of the yoginī group is called the animal victim.
plain_english: In the Kula tradition, he who is situated in the midst of the group of yoginīs is called the animal victim.
